title: New quote
purpose: Start a client draft; enter prices and terms on the next page.
summary: Start a quote for a client. You add prices, validity and terms on the next page; the client sees nothing until you issue it.

tasks.title: Start a quote
steps: Choose the [[Client]] and enter a [[Title]] that describes the work.
Select [[Create quote]]. The quote gets its QT number as draft version 1 and the draft editor opens.

tasks.title: Quote for one of the client's projects
steps: Choose the client first, then pick the [[Project]].
The project must belong to that client; a project of another client is refused.

good_to_know: The client cannot be changed later in the draft editor. Pick the right one now.
The client cannot see a draft. It becomes visible only when a version is issued.
Selecting Create quote twice for the same request creates only one quote.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Project managers can create and change quotes; admins inherit this operational role. Client accounts cannot use staff pages or make staff decisions.

items.label: Client
items.description: Required active client. Establishes ownership and cannot be changed through the later draft editor.

items.label: Project
items.description: Optional active project belonging to the selected client. Other clients’ active projects may appear in the options, but a mismatch is rejected.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required description up to 160 characters; surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: Create quote
items.description: Assign a QT number, create draft version 1, record the creator and open the draft editor. Retrying the same creation request returns the same record. The client cannot see this draft.

items.label: Cancel / Quotes
items.description: Return to quotes without creating a record.

items.label: Required fields and errors
items.description: Asterisks mark required fields. Errors appear beside fields or above the form; entered values stay available for correction after validation fails. A stale-record error requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: When this form opens in a dialog, change its size without saving. Small screens already use the full screen.

items.label: Close form / Cancel
items.description: Leave without saving. If the dialog detects edits, Keep editing returns to the form and Discard changes leaves without saving.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Retry if loading the dialog failed. During saving, wait for the request to finish; the submit button indicates work is running.
